verdict.rationale: Plaid's docs mention verifying 'identification documents' and 'global ID documents' broadly (plaid-idv-docs-1, plaid-idv-docs-12), but there is no published breakdown of supported countries or specific document types (passports, national IDs, driver licenses, residence permits) as the story requires. missing for 10: a published country/document-type coverage list, explicit mention of residence permits or driver licenses, independent corroboration of document breadth.
